title: An ended session's coord intent keeps showing to later sessions for a day, also after a clean SessionEnd
goal: SP-xo45jvbj review G4 (ST-x6mvfnmv): SessionEnd releases only the presence lease, and coord.py digest shows an intent for 24 h unless a later progress done covers its items, so a worker resumed or re-dispatched on the same item is shown its own earlier session as an overlap and told to ask the operator. After a clean SessionEnd, the session's intents no longer show (a progress or release it posts), and a crashed session's drop out with its lease.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite'))
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','work/ST-abcd1234')
hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-sessA',source='startup');hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-sessA',reason='exit')
out=hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionStart',session_id='repro-sessB',source='startup');hook(r,hook_event_name='SessionEnd',session_id='repro-sessB',reason='exit')
print(repr(out[:300]));sys.exit(0 if 'repro-sessA' not in out else 1)
